items.title: How do we define India?
items.explanation: India is defined by its physical geography as a land between the Himalayas and the two seas, where spiritual and cultural unity was made complete in ancient times. Today, it has defined borders, states, and a known population.

items.title: What were the ancient names for India?
items.explanation: Ancient texts like the Ṛig Veda gave the name 'Sapta Sindhava' (land of seven rivers). The Mahābhārata used terms like 'Bhāratavarṣha' (country of the Bharatas) and 'Jambudvīpa' (island of the jambul tree), which scholars agree refers to the entire Indian Subcontinent.
